name: User-Agent Parser
summary: Parse User-Agent strings into browser, OS, device, and bot detection fields.
description: Paste any HTTP User-Agent string to see browser name and version, rendering engine, operating system, device type, and whether it looks like a bot or crawler. Includes sample UAs for Chrome, Safari, Firefox, curl, and Googlebot.

faqs.question: How accurate is the parsing?
faqs.answer: Common browsers, mobile devices, curl, and well-known bots are recognized with regex heuristics. Custom or rare UAs may show Unknown for some fields.

faqs.question: Is my User-Agent sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Parsing runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Can I detect bots?
faqs.answer: Yes. Known crawler patterns (Googlebot, Bingbot, etc.) are flagged in the Bot field.
